measured_result.scope: Lifecycle-only original-pin/exact-history and rollup validation after prior accepted full gate; not new mathematics, review, build, render or page view.

rollup_preparation.command:
/usr/bin/python3.10 -I -S -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
p=Path('/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/papers/209-ordered-fibre-threading')
m=p/'PAPER_MANIFEST.sha256'
old=m.read_text()
assert hashlib.sha256(old.encode()).hexdigest()=='cd8b345c2e8c7e71afa9d2d2d64e6ca74332828b4447e43ba6894c5a8398a4b2'
assert m.read_bytes()==(p/'frozen_round1/ROUND1_ACCEPTANCE/PRE_ROUND1_PAPER_MANIFEST.sha256').read_bytes()
rows={}
for line in old.splitlines():
 h,n=line.split('  ',1)
 assert n not in rows and hashlib.sha256((p/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h
 rows[n]=h
allfiles=list(p.rglob('*'))
assert all(not q.is_symlink() for q in allfiles)
extra=sorted(q for q in allfiles if q.is_file() and q!=m and q.relative_to(p).as_posix() not in rows)
assert len(extra)==2004 and all(q.is_relative_to(p/'frozen_round1') for q in extra)
add=''.join(hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest()+'  '+q.relative_to(p).as_posix()+'\n' for q in extra)
lines=old.splitlines()
anchor=next(line for line in lines if line.split('  ',1)[1]>'frozen_round1/')
assert all(line.split('  ',1)[1]<'frozen_round1/' for line in lines[:lines.index(anchor)])
print(json.dumps({'anchor':anchor,'addition':add,'old_entries':len(rows),'new_entries':len(rows)+len(extra)}))
PY
